related.title: James Webb 太空望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付點源剖面、取樣比與誤差預算，不把插值像元當新資訊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver point-source profiles,sampling ratios and error budget without treating interpolated pixels as new information.
related.difference: 計算譜線紅移與解析需求，區分單線猜測與多線一致識別。
related.differenceEn: Calculate line redshift and resolution requirements,distinguishing a single-line guess from consistent multi-line identification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先用公尺算弧度，再轉角秒與像元數，逐步檢查 nm 換算。
分別算 z 與 R，說明兩者皆無量綱但意義不同。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate radians in metres,then convert to arcseconds and pixels,checking the nm conversion.
Calculate z and R separately and explain their different meanings despite both being dimensionless.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WMAP 微波異向性探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付點源剖面、取樣比與誤差預算，不把插值像元當新資訊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver point-source profiles,sampling ratios and error budget without treating interpolated pixels as new information.
related.difference: 由差分觀測重建小型天空圖，辨識不可觀測的共同常數與閉合殘差。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct a small sky map from differences and identify the unobservable common offset and closure residual.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先用公尺算弧度，再轉角秒與像元數，逐步檢查 nm 換算。
設 C=0，依兩差值求 A、B，再用第三差值獨立查核。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate radians in metres,then convert to arcseconds and pixels,checking the nm conversion.
Set C=0,solve A and B from two differences and check the third independently.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
